Brain malformations and pancreatic agenesis establish neurologic, gastrointestinal and endocrine disease. Gallbladder agenesis in 2/3 supports hepatic involvement.

The metabolic defect is primary. Pulmonary arterial hypertension and hepatic enzyme elevation occur in 2/2; associated hepatomegaly supports hepatic injury. Small-cohort uncertainty is appropriately acknowledged.

Oral clefts, cutaneous webs and skeletal abnormalities establish the primary axes. Microphthalmia and corneal opacity support ocular involvement; confidence appropriately reflects the single annotated patient.
Chorea, developmental delay and intellectual disability establish neurologic disease without evidence of another directly damaged organ.
Add metabolic_endocrine to primary: this is an extra-adrenal paraganglionic neuroendocrine tumor, even when nonsecretory. Its vagal location also supports neurologic primary.

corrected.basis: Tumor arises from neuroendocrine paraganglia associated with the vagus nerve; usually nonsecretory. Dysphagia and vocal cord paralysis do not establish additional organ damage.
